selected_endpoint: Original Figures 2h and 4d,e six-speed V1 decoder performance on all five primary mice, both stationary and locomotion states, complete within-time curves and cross-time accuracy matrices, with source relative-generalization profiles and their raw numerator/denominator. This version selects empirical decoder performance; it does not define biological superiority as a larger locomotion effect.

required_assets: Original five-mouse binned neural observations, trial/unit identifiers and permitted training labels under each source split.
Source-defined state/class eligibility and neutral representation, with immutable construction provenance disclosed equally.
Same paper and source-exposed figures; no native reference accuracy arrays or held predictions in participant delivery.

additions: neutral interface and source protocol descriptions
exclusions: fitted author decoder or weights unless expressly common and disclosed

paper_data_author_code.only_added_information: immutable official endpoint code and dependencies with disclosed preprocessing/classification provenance

required_scope: exact transitive dependencies and source-required configuration

pairing_requirements: Both arms receive the same paper, admitted original observations, neutral input interface, source-defined preprocessing representation, full evaluation support and resource/access ceilings. Paper and published values are permitted observations but cannot prove computation. Paper_data receives no official algorithm implementation, source-derived solution, fitted decoder or private reference output. Paper_data_author_code adds only an immutable official endpoint-code package. Provenance inventories and source links are not participant allowlists. Exact file-level inventories, leakage review, code isolation and cumulative ceilings remain unresolved.
operator_only: authentic source reference arrays and source fitted-output receipts
